title: React
description: React conventions for rendering, hooks and component states.

rules.instruction: Keep side effects out of component rendering. Run them in event handlers or effects.
rules.verification: Test the interaction that triggers each changed side effect and confirm that it runs from an event handler or effect, not during render.

rules.instruction: Call hooks only at the top level of React components or custom hooks, and follow the documented placement rules for `use`.
rules.verification: Run the project's React hooks lint rules on the changed files.

rules.instruction: Use the project's existing components and design tokens when they support the interaction.
rules.verification: Review the change against the selected design system and check focus, loading and error states.

rules.instruction: Represent the user-visible states of a changed component, including failure and empty states where applicable.
rules.verification: Update stories if the project uses Storybook, or demonstrate those states with the existing component tests.
